title: Minimum Valid Base of a Number String

content.problemStatement: Write a program to find the current least base of the given number
content.outputFormat: Print the least base of the number

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.
Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Find minimum base B such that the given number string is valid in base B.
solution.editorial: The minimum valid base is max(digits) + 1.

hints: In base B, all digits must be < B.
